approved_direction: User: Ok go. Build a simplified articulated Vulpin, validate untextured motion before painted materials.
scope: Isolated geometric animation review, not runtime hero integration.
steps: Build an editable Blender armature and low-detail fox mannequin with fixed bone lengths.
Animate a continuous walk with two foot IK targets, alternating world-locked stance, and opposite arm swing.
Check evaluated bone lengths, actual stance displacement, floor height, loop continuity and game camera projection.
Bake four orientations with one common scale and root; show the mannequin on native dungeon paving.
Deliver animated previews and the editable .blend; record visual and technical limits.
